transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I know people at my apartment are watching when I come and go. They’ve been slipping notes about me to the office, even though everybody keeps telling me they’re just regular notices on the doors.
Have you been hearing voices, whispers, or sounds that other people don't seem to hear?
No, I haven’t noticed hearing voices or sounds like that.
About how long have you been noticing that people are watching you and leaving these notes?
About a year and a month now. It’s been going on for a while.
Over the past year, have you been feeling persistently down, depressed, or hopeless?
Yeah. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling, like the day’s already gone bad before I even get out of bed.
Have there been times over this past year when you felt people were watching you, but you weren't feeling depressed at all?
Yeah. There were a few weeks when I was eating a little better and not waking up feeling so hopeless, but I still believed the neighbors were watching my door and reporting on me.
Have you been using any recreational drugs, medications, or alcohol over the past year?
I’m not sure what you mean exactly—like, prescription medicine or things outside of that?
I mean things like marijuana, street drugs, or alcohol—have you been using any of those over the past year?
I... I’m not really sure how to answer that. I don’t know what counts as using, exactly.
Even if it's just once in a while or in small amounts, do you drink alcohol or use any recreational substances?
I don’t know... I’m having a hard time saying for sure what I’ve used or how often.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical conditions or physical illnesses by a doctor?
I’m not sure. I don’t really know if I’ve been diagnosed with anything physical.
Have you seen things, people, or shadows that other people couldn't see?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed seeing people or shadows that nobody else could see.
Do you ever feel that your thoughts are being controlled, placed into your mind, or broadcast so that others can hear them?

I don’t know about my thoughts being broadcast, but I do know the people at my apartment are watching when I come and go. They slip notes about me to the office. Everyone says they’re just notices on the doors, but I don’t think that’s true.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in the things you usually enjoy doing?

Yeah. I used to look forward to choir practice, playing bridge, cooking beans on Sundays, doing little repair jobs for people. Now I mostly let the phone ring and tell myself there’s no point in going.
Have you had trouble organizing your thoughts, or noticed that your words get jumbled and hard for others to follow?

Yeah, sometimes. I’ll start explaining something about the rent, then I’m talking about the marina, the choir robes, and the wires in the walls. People look at me like I left out half of what I meant to say.
Looking back over this past year and a month, would you say you've felt depressed for most of that time?
Yeah... for most of the time since I moved, I’ve felt pretty low. Even on days when I could talk a little clearer, I still felt useless and didn’t care about the things I used to enjoy.
